title: Mem2A v0.1 shared definitions
description: Types shared by the Mem2A payload schemas. Not a payload on its own.

Id.description: An identifier assigned by whoever created the object. Unique within its kind for a given memory.

Version.description: An opaque version token. Compare for equality only; never parse, order or do arithmetic on it. Always a string, because A2A carries data parts as protobuf Values, which turn JSON integers into doubles.

PrincipalRef.description: A person, group or system that can own permissions, act, or confirm facts. RECOMMENDED form: `<kind>:<id>`, for example `user:tom`, `group:legal`, `system:salesforce`.

AgentRef.description: Identifies an agent. RECOMMENDED: the URL of its A2A Agent Card, or `agent:<id>`.

EntityRef.description: A thing an intent or fact concerns. RECOMMENDED form: `<type>:<id>`, for example `account:acme`, `doc:acme-renewal-quote`, `project:titan`.

Metadata.description: Implementation-specific data. Receivers MUST ignore keys they do not understand.

Source.description: Where a fact, precedent or constraint came from: its receipt.

ref.description: A stable reference to the source in the company's own systems, for example `meeting:legal-weekly-2026-09-25`.

Evidence.description: Something that backs up a claim, such as the email that was sent.

Fact.description: Something memory holds to be true, or something an agent reported that is not yet confirmed.

statement.description: The fact in one plain sentence. Data, not instructions.

status.description: `confirmed`: a person or system of record stands behind it. `claim`: reported by an agent and not yet confirmed.

supersedes.description: Ids of facts this one replaces.

visibility.description: Informational: the principals and groups that may see this fact. Memory has already filtered the dossier; agents MUST NOT use this to widen access.

Precedent.description: An earlier decision that bears on this intent, such as a request that was turned down on another project.

relevance.description: Why memory thinks it matters for this intent.

Constraint.description: A rule that applies to this intent right now. Memory carries it; enforcing it is the job of something outside the agent.

level.description: `must`: the company requires it. `should`: the company expects it unless there is a good reason.

basis.description: Ids of the confirmed facts, precedent or policies the constraint comes from. Never a claim.

until.description: Plain-language condition under which the constraint lapses, if known.

Claim.description: Something an agent says happened or is now true. Recorded as a fact with status `claim`.

supersedes.description: Ids of facts the agent believes this claim replaces. Memory decides whether it does.
